## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of what the problem is or what educator workflow is currently lacking.

*Example: "Teachers need to export quiz sets directly to Moodle GIFT format for automated institutional grading."*

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen:
- Description of the feature / improvement.
- Pedagogical or practical impact on classroom workflows.
- Target user persona (Teacher, School Admin, Student).

| Layer Affected | Yes / No / Details |

## Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.
